plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp build phase for boxing with one short weekly S&C session. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body strength lift, then Weeks 2-4 build force and power with low exercise count, clear intent, and recoverable volume that fits around skill work. The parent 12-week cycle keeps building through Week 8, then shifts toward sharper power and speed expression in Weeks 9-12. Week 1 is for establishing training maxes, and the main program starts in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body strength and simple explosive qualities with beginner-friendly exercises that fit short off-camp sessions.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same main patterns with slightly heavier strength work and crisp power output while keeping fatigue controlled.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep enough strength while shifting more emphasis toward fast, sharp, boxing-friendly power and speed expression.
